🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 5)
Channel: alert-runtime-monitoring  •  bug-type guess: data  •  alerts in group: 1
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)

Symptoms:
  - default_web_site/reportgenerationapi error rate hit ~17.5% (threshold 5%) between 19:36-19:52Z, first-ever fire of this monitor (created 2026-08-25)
  - All 27 ES hits trace to a single account (innuwindow2), 13 repeated attempts over 16 minutes, every attempt failing the same two ways
  - (1) System.ArgumentNullException in DevExpress report-layout deserialization (ReportGeneration.cs:87) — corrupted/incompatible saved report layout
  - (2) System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException "Invalid column name 'TxnDate'/'SalesRep_RecordID'" (Data.cs:213) — report SQL references columns absent from this tenant's schema
  - Extrapolation: not warranted — error is account-specific (single account across both hosts, both indices)

Trace IDs: dd_trace_id 6a9489ed0000000015284676468b7982 (sample SqlException span)
Likely cause: account innuwindow2's saved report is broken — corrupted layout + missing SQL columns for this tenant's schema; repeated retries all fail identically
Suggested next action: file defect — legacy-reportgeneration-api / CRM Experience, account innuwindow2 (repo not accessible this cycle: methodcrm-org GH_TOKEN 403 gap, so no diff proposed)
